subject: ACME RAG eval — post-call recap & recommended next steps
message_1_subject: ACME RAG eval — post-call recap & recommended next steps
message_1_body:
Hi Jordan / Priya -

Thanks again for a great discussion today. Quick recap from our side plus recommended next steps to keep momentum on the RAG POC.

TL;DR recommended stack and immediate asks:
- Model candidates: redwood-7b-v1 (strong grounding + latency balance), redwood-3b-q4k (cost-sensitive baseline), and a smaller safety-tuned reranker model (rwrk-1b).
- Retriever approach: hybrid dense + BM25 with dense top_k=100, bm25 for hard negatives. Candidate pool to reranker: top_k_rerank=16.
- Evaluation focus: grounding precision@1/3, hallucination rate (manual spot-checks), and information retrieval latency.
- Next step: we’ll run a focused eval on your 2k prompt set + 50 labeled queries, share the dashboard and a recommended config.

Action items (owners):
1) Marissa: deliver initial eval summary + dashboard link and attach prompt set we used (today EOD).
2) Logan: run reranker ablation (cross-encoder vs distilled) and share perf numbers (2 business days).
3) Jordan/Priya: confirm whether we should include full product docs + internal KB in the retriever index or limit to customer-facing docs.

Links / attachments included:
- Eval dashboard: https://app.redwood.ai/evals/ACME-42
- Attached: acme_rag_eval_summary.pdf, acme_prompt_set_v1.jsonl, acme_eval_baseline.csv

Notes on risk/quality: we saw a few cases in the baseline where the model produced plausible but unsupported answers (hallucination). To mitigate we recommend trying the reranker-first flow (high precision at top) + a grounding threshold for passage scores. We’ll surface concrete examples in the summary.

Proposed follow-up: 30-minute sync Wed Aug 11 to review results and decide on retriever indexing scope. If that works for you please send a calendar invite (or I can).

Thanks -
Marissa

message_2_subject: Re: ACME RAG eval — post-call recap & recommended next steps
message_2_body:
Thanks Marissa - super helpful summary. A couple quick answers: 

- We want the retriever to index both product docs and internal KB for the POC (search surface = public + internal how-tos). We’ll provide sanitized extracts for anything with PII.
- Wed Aug 11 at 10am PT works for Priya + me. Please go ahead and send an invite.

Two quick asks from our side: 
1) Can you include a small smoke run (100 queries) with the hybrid retriever + redwood-3b-q4k as a low-cost baseline before the larger 2k run? We want to validate latency/cost tradeoffs.
2) For the reranker ablation, can you also include a lightweight lexical reranker (BM25 re-score) so we can see simple vs learned impact?

Appreciate it - looking forward to the dashboard.

--Jordan

message_3_subject: Re: ACME RAG eval — post-call recap & recommended next steps
message_3_body:
Thanks Jordan - we can do both asks. Quick notes on the plan from the infra/experiments side:

- Smoke run (100 queries) with hybrid retriever + redwood-3b-q4k: we’ll report avg latency, p95, and token cost estimate. Expect the smoke run results by EOD Aug 6.
- Reranker ablation: cross-encoder (rwrk-1b), distilled cross-encoder (rwrk-1b-dist), and BM25 rescoring baseline. We’ll produce precision@1/3, reranker latency, and CPU/GPU cost per query. Target delivery: Aug 9 end of day.
- Grounding metrics we’ll surface: precision@1 (is the top answer supported by a retrieved doc), grounding score distribution, and a small human-labeled hallucination rate. We’ll also include example failure cases with suggested mitigations (prompt tweaks, stricter passage thresholds).

Follow-ups: Marissa - I’ll need the exact prompt set and the list of docs to include in the index (you’ll attach / Jordan will upload). Also tagging this for a short runbook: recommended index config (dense encoder model, vector dims, chunk size), which I’ll sketch in the deliverable.

Thanks -
Logan
